programmes.d: Ali Klay, a formidable boxer raised by a ruthless tycoon, becomes the trusted right-hand man of a powerful car-trading empire. Hated by the family that never accepted him, he is torn between loyalty and betrayal-until a buried secret threatens to change everything.

Mohamed Salah Fakhr, an ambitious and creative young man from a Delta village, dreams of breaking into the world of advertising. Far from the capital's lights, he struggles against social and geographic barriers, determined to prove his talent and bring his artistic vis.

Farawla, a real estate guard's daughter turned cup-reading enthusiast, takes a twist in her story when she becomes a sales rep for an international accessory company. Brace for a whirlwind of positivity, wealth, and joy in this enchanting journey.
The seventh part witnesses marital disputes and problems between El-Kebir and Marbouha, a year after their marriage, in a comic framework.
Set in a local neighbourhood, a lady runs the small liver restaurant she inherited from her father, but her life changes drastically as she falls in love.

Through the complex bond between a mother and her daughters, the series explores human contradictions and shifting emotions as generations clash and desires intertwine. Behind closed doors, secrets, romance, and marital struggles test the strength of a family in a chang.

Sodfa is a history teacher who finds herself burdened with a responsibility to tell her hairdresser,Fouad Mahran, the owner of a famous regional chain salon, that his daughter is cheating on her husband with another man.

A famous actress hiding her pain and a lonely coach haunted by his past meet during a life-saving moment. As old wounds resurface and rumors surround them, they stand together, questioning whether love will be their salvation or their downfall.

After rescuing a child from a blazing house, a brave man suffers a devastating fall that leaves him in a coma and erases his memory. When he awakens, he begins a gripping journey to uncover his past and his true identity.
The series continues to show the heroism of the army and police in the fight against terrorism during the Brotherhood's period of rule in Egypt.

Saber Al Maddah is a religious man who is well-loved among his people. But when he falls in love, he loses everything in a moment of uncontrollable rage after he kills the closest person to his beloved, thus turning his life upside down.

When a Kuwaiti family begins to fall apart, four siblings take life-changing steps to heal old wounds, confront buried secrets, and rediscover what truly binds them together. A high-emotion, slow-burn drama about love, loss, and second chances.
